scope: 四个容器布局、三个可扩容容器与七个仓管的角色私人仓储服务；侠客行囊独立重量及门禁沿唯一owner，不是完整物品权限表。

authority.item_permissions: each explicitly adopted item definition; missing permission or unknown item is configuration error, never default allow/deny
authority.source_policy: NPC原名/钱庄仓储职责取已归档正文；容量/价格/重量/跨城共享和货币规则均是项目采用。南林原文明确存免费、取收费，未给金额；本地费用不回填原文。

containers.acceptance: only stackable item categories explicitly assigned here by their definitions
only instance categories explicitly assigned here by their definitions; one instance per slot
only explicit warehouse-permitted items; preserve binding, expiry, quest ownership and instance/stack identity
only stack definitions explicitly permitting knight_bag; no instances or automatic alternate destination

carried_weight.legal_overweight_state: 角色总携重沿弓手原来源/修订凭证；侠客行囊分区超重另沿侠客行囊owner的到期来源证明，二者独立且动作限制取交集。无来源拒绝，不自动删物。

service_eligibility.close_or_leave_range: invalidate service session/quotes; keep already committed results
service_eligibility.concurrent_commands: host serializes per-character state revision; stale revision rejected
service_eligibility.lan_authority: host validates the requester's own character, containers and carried silver; never party leader or another player's account
service_eligibility.challenge_gate: forbids_active_challenge按原统一effective_challenge查询；活跃本体null但本T末步捕获未终止仍禁止，缺父证明/残留捕获拒绝，不将查询错误当无挑战。

deposit_items.requires: explicit warehouse permission, source ownership/quantity/revision, no reserved recipe inputs or protected quest quantity violation
deposit_items.layout: compute all destination merge/split slots and remove all source quantities as one transaction
deposit_items.item_state: preserve definition, binding, expiry, quest owner and all growth state; do not clone instances

withdraw_items.fee_formula: sum(selected physical item quantities) * silver_fee_per_unit; each unique instance counts one, not one per occupied stack
withdraw_items.requires: positive exact quantities, correct owner/revision, final destination slots and carried weight legal; valid overweight receipt may not acquire additional positive weight
withdraw_items.failure: preserve warehouse/carried silver/items/slots; do not auto-reduce quantity or choose another bag

deposit_silver.requires: carried silver >= amount and warehouse_silver + amount <= maximum_exact_integer
deposit_silver.result: carried silver -= amount; warehouse_silver += amount, one transaction

withdraw_silver.requires: warehouse_silver >= amount and carried silver + amount <= maximum_exact_integer
withdraw_silver.result: warehouse_silver -= amount; carried silver += amount, one transaction

expand_container.cross_npc_state: same character expansion levels; switching NPC never resets count or price

move_knight_bag_items.source_and_destination: 明确本人inventory与knight_bag相反两分区；不扫描或自动改投
move_knight_bag_items.boundary: 原严格三阶段/日志/索引已登记，完整共同父与运行仍待，不能执行。

transaction.quote: bind operation, exact instance/stack IDs and quantities, destination and total fee to session and revision; submission recomputes and rejects stale quote
sequence: validate service session, NPC range/alive/map, role eligibility and command deduplication
validate item IDs/permissions/ownership, source quantities, silver and exact integer ranges
calculate final merge/split layout, instance ownership, slots and carried weight on a candidate snapshot
commit all items, silver, capacity levels, revision and settlement receipt once
persist by the existing profile/LAN result protocol; do not rerun committed operation on save failure or retry
transaction.duplicate_command: return existing result, no second fee/transfer/expansion
transaction.sorting: permitted in own bags/warehouse; stable ordering and explicit merge keys from 17; no quantities or permissions changed

unresolved_scope: all remaining source NPC services, goods, prices and task bindings
complete item category/permission definitions and income/expense balance
Godot UI/navigation/transactions, crash recovery and multi-machine LAN tests

design_review.scope: schema/reference/position and arithmetic examples, not Godot storage execution
not_executed: stale session/repeated command and save fault recovery

persistent_layout.registry_key: 各注册表键等于正文stack_id/instance_id；同角色及跨角色真实现持身份不得重复。只保当前本角色实物，不含preview/他人历史输出或复购保管。
persistent_layout.containers: character.inventory/equipment_bag/warehouse各精确expansion_level与slots；slots仅存占用格，条目精确slot_index/kind/target_id，slot从0起且严格递增不重复，空格由未出现索引表示。容量只从本合同扩容式推导，不保存第二份capacity。 character.knight_bag精确单键slots，同样三键槽条目且slot_index=0..19，最多20项；无expansion_level/weight/capacity持久镜像，物品权限与服务余时联合验证。 character.knight_bag_overweight_or_null为必有nullable历史来源，沿侠客行囊owner核真实到期及当前减负链。
persistent_layout.equipment: character.loadouts精确primary/secondary两组各14槽；character.gems精确6位；空槽显式null，非空为唯一实例ID。active_loadout_id仅primary/secondary。完整槽表按装备组与宝珠.v1.json，不允许缩回11槽。
persistent_layout.closure: 两正文注册表每条恰好被一个正式容器槽/装备组槽/宝珠位引用；每个位置引用必须解析到正确种类、正确本角色owner和实际定义，注册表孤立条目/悬空引用/重复槽号/同ID跨位置均拒绝，不自动整理或删除修复。实例owner与外层角色必须一致，不能借注册表搬移重写所有权。
persistent_layout.instance_dispatch: equipment_instances每条通过已采用装备实例完整schema唯一分派，item_stacks每条通过物品堆完整schema；注册表禁止空白键/非对象/不完整正文或未知装备定义，逐定义权限/任务scope仍须业务校验。owned_inventory_state严格联合十一个原平铺字段，不新建inventory_state持久包装，不复制正文；完整角色根须另保全角色白名单，不能先删未知字段再抽取十一键通过校验。
validation_order: 严格JSON/token/布局白名单与容量
两注册表键与正文身份及逐定义完整类型
所有正式位置引用解析/全局单一位置/注册表恰好闭合
容器类别与仓储权限、装备槽兼容及合法暂失资格来源
堆上限/任务持有与保护量/来源流和实例来源
全部随身位置重量与合法超重凭证
候选变更后重查并原子保存正文/引用/费用/修订/收据
persistent_layout.revision: inventory_revision严格非负安全整数，任何实际布局/容量/数量/实例库存状态变更的一个正式事件恰加1；同事件多个位置仅一次，纯预览和无变化排序不加。角色业务revision同事件按原owner增加，协议guard元数据不冒充库存变更。溢出拒绝。
persistent_layout.initial: 正式新角色三容器expansion_level=0/slots=[]、两正文表={}、inventory_revision=0、两组14槽及6宝珠位=null、active_loadout_id=primary；这是礼包前基线，22实际礼包唯一提交后相应写正文/位置/来源及修订，不持久化空基线后重发。 character.knight_bag显式{slots:[]}，不分配实物或改礼包目的地。 knight_bag_overweight_or_null显式null。
persistent_layout.legacy: 四组已知旧档导入为新角色初始化两空正文表及三0扩容容器，再按原背包顺序占连续槽和原weapon/armor对应primary.weapon/body；实际堆超定义上限须按原数量拆堆预检容量，拒绝溢出，不免费扩容/丢物。其他位置null、active=primary，实际导入与来源/库存修订同结算。目标其他角色/world不变；新格式缺布局字段拒绝。 四已知旧来源的新导入角色knight_bag显式{slots:[]}；已有目标角色保原合法分区，不把旧背包物移入新分区。 新导入角色knight_bag_overweight_or_null显式null，既有目标角色保原合法来源。
persistent_layout.buyback: 复购保管独立会话域不进角色持有注册表；真实出售/复购/清空必须原子转移并守恒。可复购物正文保管与退出故障适配仍待，不以简单删注册表代替。

container_definition_resolution: 药品、普通材料与盒均按逐定义进入inventory，共享同一容量/槽序；consumable_bag不是正式容器ID，不做运行时别名映射。最后一件输入消费释放的inventory槽可容纳本次新输出，输入余堆仍占槽；最终完整布局统一预检。equipment_bag/warehouse/knight_bag仍按各自精确权限和位置规则。
